uncited: Voxel Format Generation converts 3D Gaussian Splats into a sparse voxel octree optimized for collision detection, outputting metadata and binary data files.

It distinguishes itself from general-purpose voxelizers by integrating scene topology analysis (interior vs. exterior) and generating watertight collision meshes directly from the voxel grid, rather than just visual representation.
The method processes 3D Gaussian primitives to produce a sparse voxel octree structure.
It involves filtering, spatial discretization, topological filling/carving, and optional mesh extraction.
The binary format stores the octree nodes, while the JSON stores metadata.
Voxels with opacity below this are treated as empty.
Empty XZ areas larger than $2 \times \text{floorFillDilation}$ from any solid column are treated as exterior.
*   For **exterior scenes** (terrain): Apply `--voxel-floor-fill` to fill ground beneath surfaces.
**Mesh Generation (Optional):** Generate a collision mesh using `--collision-mesh`.
It is designed for preparing 3D Gaussian Splat data for physics and collision detection in interactive applications.
